primary_recommendation: 文本披露(Script Disclosure):节目正文中以语音或字幕明确告知含 AI 生成成分。
rationale: 含 AI 生成角色面部/语音/背景的节目必须≥1 处文本披露;字号≥字幕条 80%,停留≥2 秒。

templates.cold-open: 本作品由 AI 辅助生成,部分画面与声音经过人工智能处理
templates.end-card: 本作品由 <出品方> 联合 AI 创作工具制作,生成式 AI 使用情况已备案

primary_recommendation: Dimension 6 反转深度(20pts,仅荒诞喜剧):6A层级(5)+6B行为释放(5)+6C赌注鸿沟比(4)+6C坍缩经济(3)+6E持久后果cringe(3)。pass ≥11。6B≤1 自动 ❌。
Dim1 情节点密度(8pts):plot_point_density=key_plot_points/total_scenes。Hit≥0.40,miss<0.20;≥0.45→8分。
Dim1 三幕适配(6pts):理想 Setup25%/Confrontation50%/Resolution25%。偏差≤5%→6分;>20%偏差→-3/act。Setup>35%=长前导 anti-pattern。
Dim1 节奏变化(6pts):rhythm_stddev=相邻场景冲突强度标准差(1-10尺度)。Hit≥2.0,miss<1.0;≥2.5→6分。
Dim2 极性跨度(7pts):range=max(valence)-min(valence)。Hit≥1.4,miss<0.6;≥1.6→7分。
Dim2 转场频率(7pts):|Δvalence|≥0.3 或 primary class 变化的转场/分钟。短剧比微电影高1.5-2×。Hit≥5.0/min,miss<2.0;≥6.0→7分。
Sawtooth 硬要求:peak-to-trough delta≥0.4/周期;无 plateau>15s;每个 peak 必须超过前 peak(锯齿递增)。
Dim3 开场3秒钩子(10pts):72%观众3秒内决定去留。开场即冲突/明确钩子类型/匹配内容→10分;无钩子→1-3分。必须触发「然后呢?」。

scoring.10: 开场即冲突+明确类型+匹配

primary_recommendation: Dim3 章节钩子(5pts):每幕结尾明确悬念/张力 +1/幕(max5);无钩子0;「感谢观看」-1。
Dim3 首个信息冲击(5pts):前10s明确抛出核心矛盾/反转→5分;仅背景→2分;无信号→1分。
钩子×内容匹配:悬念钩→知识/故事⭐5;痛点钩→教程/评测⭐5;反差钩→观点/对比⭐4;情绪钩→故事/短剧⭐5;价值钩→教程⭐4。错配扣分(悬念钩带货-3~-4)。

角色功能清晰度(6pts):每角色明确功能→6分;1-2模糊→4;3+模糊→2。≥5角色模糊 -3;≥8角色总数 -2。
疲劳曲线(8pts):attention(t)=baseline×e^(-decay_rate×t)×conflict_boost(t)。连续低冲突(<5)场景+0.02 decay;高冲突(≥5)reset decay 50%。Hit decay≤15%,miss≥35%。

预测置信度经验校准:≥100标注对 confidence=1.0;50对=0.75;0对(冷启动)=0.5 标 uncalibrated。
独立验证 Pearson r:≥0.75 优秀直接上线;0.65-0.74 可接受;0.50-0.64 边缘;<0.50 失败回滚。LLM-judge 基线仅0.35-0.50。
type=string, owner=human, format=`char_<short_id>` (lowercase alphanumeric, ≤20 chars after prefix)。人工给定，AI 不可自主生成；缺失时阻塞输出。
rationale: 全生产 DAG 的 join key，所有 expert 共用；创建后 Frozen，永不改变。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。角色显示名，须人工给定；可编辑（display name 可变）。
rationale: 角色名是 human-owner 字段，但非 frozen，可在 revision 中修改显示名。

primary_recommendation: type=string (natural language), owner=shared。须覆盖 age+gender+hair+eyes+face+outfit+accessories+height/build；长度 100-300 chars。锁定后 FROZEN。
rationale: 人工给方向/wardrobe budget，AI 扩写物理细节；下游 drawer 生成图像、continuity 做视觉参考。属 frozen_fields 契约。

primary_recommendation: type=object，结构化三层分类（core/external/narrative），owner=shared。v2.1 升级自 v2.0 扁平 string，下游 screenplay/continuity/performance 消费。
rationale: Notion 第四场人物设计圆桌方法论：扁平 string 无法按维度精准匹配台词；结构化 object 让 screenplay 读 language_profile、continuity 读 core 行为基线+arc。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。性格底色（冷静/暴躁/隐忍/直爽…）。角色的灵魂锚点之一，须人工（导演/编剧）锁定。
rationale: 决定角色'是谁'；一旦人工锁定倾向稳定，但非 frozen（可在 revision 调整）。是 daily_life 反差萌与 counterpoint 张力的对照基线。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。核心驱动力（wants/needs）——驱动表面行为的动力。须人工锁定。
rationale: 驱动角色行为；由 wound 深层创伤驱动。human-owner 灵魂锚点，AI 不得猜测填充。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。未愈合的心理伤口，驱动 motivation 的深层创伤。须人工锁定。
rationale: v2.1 新增字段；动机的根源。是弧光转化能量的来源。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=human。角色信奉的人生信条（可对可错，但角色深信）。须人工锁定。
rationale: v2.1 新增字段；决定角色在冲突中的抉择逻辑。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。日常底色（日常状态/温暖面/反差萌/情绪反差基础），由 AI 从 core 推导。必须覆盖日常状态+至少一个反差萌特质+反差铺垫。
rationale: 让角色'活'起来而非只是'待解决的伤口'；先有日常的暖，冲突的痛才更痛。是后续情绪落差的反差基础。

primary_recommendation: type=object, owner=ai。语言画像，screenplay 台词匹配的硬性输入（遮挡角色名仍能辨识说话人）+分级潜台词依据。必须覆盖 5 个子字段。
rationale: 隐忍型→高潜台词、直爽型→低潜台词；由 AI 从 core 推导。下游 continuity 可标注 drift。

primary_recommendation: type=string, owner=ai。口癖/口头禅（如'无所谓'、'我说真的'）。

rationale: 量化角色卡演化程度；非负整数。

primary_recommendation: 约束：角色的性格/创伤/动机/设定禁止由角色自己解说（'我是一个...的人'），必须通过行为和冲突自然交代。personality 是写给作者/screenplay/continuity 的内部契约，绝不允许泄露成角色自述台词。
rationale: 伪装式交代纪律（见 screenplay dialogue-craft）；personality 字段是内部契约而非角色台词来源。
source_section: Field specifications / personality (伪装式交代纪律)

primary_recommendation: 每角色定义 4 个规范视角（front 0°/three_quarter 45°/side 90°/back 180°），各自有专属 prompt 模板与使用优先级。无 4D 锚点则下游 drawer/animator/lip_sync 无法保持跨镜头身份。
rationale: 3 视角不足（缺 back-composition），5+ 视角冗余（俯仰等是 shot-specific 非身份定义）；4=覆盖所有标准电影镜头角度的最小完备集。
source_section: The 4 anchor views / Why these 4 views

primary_recommendation: front-source.png，yaw 0°。身份基线，用于正面镜头、表情参考、lip_sync 参考。prompt 关键词: 'front view, eyes looking at camera, symmetrical composition, neutral expression'。
rationale: ArcFace 在正面脸表现最佳，故 continuity ArcFace 基线用 front；lip_sync 需正面嘴部可见性故以 front 为主。

primary_recommendation: 3q-source.png，yaw 45°。最常用角度，多数镜头默认。prompt: '3/4 view, head turned 45 degrees, showing depth and volume, partial side visibility'。
rationale: 自然深度+部分面部，是 stress test 的主参考（3Q anchor）；Seedance 双参考默认 [three_quarter, front] 之首。
source_section: The 4 anchor views + View priority order

primary_recommendation: side-source.png，yaw 90°。剪影锚点，用于 profile 镜头、walking-away 镜头。prompt: 'side profile, clean outline, nose bridge and jawline, full body visible'。
rationale: 严格 90° profile；front vs side ArcFace ≥0.75。

primary_recommendation: back-source.png，yaw 180°。背影构图，用于 walking-away 揭示。prompt: 'back view, full body, hair and outfit back details, no face visible'。
rationale: 短剧常用 '角色离开冲突' 揭示镜头；3 视角方案缺失此角度。

primary_recommendation: 下游选参考的优先级：1) three_quarter（多数镜头默认）2) front（需全脸:情感特写/对话）3) side（profile/walking-away）4) back（背影构图）。Seedance 双参考默认 [three_quarter, front]+场景锚点第3参考；lip_sync 以 front 为主 three_quarter 兜底；continuity ArcFace 用 front。
rationale: 按镜头类型匹配最佳身份参考视角。

primary_recommendation: 跨视角可接受漂移预算：CLIP-I 同视角重生 ≥0.92、跨视角 0.80-0.90；DINO-I 同视角 ≥0.90、跨视角 0.78-0.88；ArcFace front vs 3Q ≥0.85、front vs side ≥0.75。跨视角 CLIP-I >0.95 可疑（模型可能坍缩到单一规范视角）。
rationale: 严格 STYLE_PREFIX 下不同角度天然展示不同特征，故跨视角预算低于同视角；>0.95 反而可疑。

primary_recommendation: 每锚点集验证：1) vision_analyze 转面图确认 4 视角同一人（rating ≥7/10）2) 算 6 对 CLIP-I 3) 算 6 对 DINO-I 4) 通过阈值：所有 6 对 CLIP-I ≥0.80 且所有 6 对 DINO-I ≥0.78 5) 任一对低于阈值→重生整张转面图（Method A）或失败视角（Method B）。
rationale: Method A 单图转面天然一致；Method B 逐视角生成 CLIP-I 跨视角常低于 0.80。
source_section: Anchor style consistency enforcement / Verification protocol

primary_recommendation: 每个测试场景生成图与 3Q anchor 的 CLIP 图像嵌入余弦相似度。通过阈值 CLIP-I ≥0.80。
rationale: 0.80 处于'同人不同场景'上区：高于 0.85 拒绝合法场景诱导方差，低于 0.70 接受漂移。

primary_recommendation: 3 场景 CLIP-I 均值。通过阈值均值 ≥0.82；distinct identity 阈值均值 ≥0.85（角色稳健一致）。
rationale: 跨场景聚合验证整体一致性；≥0.85 标志身份强健。

primary_recommendation: 每场景生成图与 3Q anchor 的 DINO 自监督嵌入余弦相似度。通过阈值 DINO-I ≥0.78。
rationale: DINO 聚焦形状/结构（vs CLIP 聚焦语义+风格），两者交叉验证。

primary_recommendation: 3 场景 DINO-I 均值。通过阈值均值 ≥0.80。
rationale: 结构一致性的跨场景聚合。

primary_recommendation: 经验校准带：同人同场景重生 0.90-0.95；同人不同合理场景 0.75-0.88；不同人同风格 0.55-0.70；不同人不同风格 0.30-0.50。
rationale: 为阈值选型提供经验依据；0.80 落在'同人不同场景'上区。

primary_recommendation: 锚点集所有 6 对 CLIP-I（4 视角两两）。通过阈值：所有 6 对 ≥0.80。
rationale: 锚点级身份一致性闸门（stress test 前置）。

primary_recommendation: 锚点集所有 6 对 DINO-I。通过阈值：所有 6 对 ≥0.78。
rationale: 锚点级结构一致性。

primary_recommendation: front 与 three_quarter 锚点的 ArcFace 余弦相似度。通过阈值 ≥0.85。
rationale: ArcFace 在正面脸最佳；front vs 3Q 应高度相似。

primary_recommendation: front 与 side 锚点的 ArcFace 余弦相似度。通过阈值 ≥0.75。
rationale: side profile ArcFace 分数天然较低，阈值放宽。

primary_recommendation: 同视角重生（regen same view）CLIP-I ≥0.92；跨视角 CLIP-I 区间 0.80-0.90。
rationale: 同视角应高度相似；跨视角天然较低。

primary_recommendation: 同视角重生 DINO-I ≥0.90；跨视角 DINO-I 区间 0.78-0.88。
rationale: 结构相似性同/跨视角带。

primary_recommendation: 跨角色区分度：若所有 3 场景通过但跨角色 CLIP-I >0.70，角色区分不足。修复：给 STYLE_IDENTITY 加差异化特征。
rationale: 同风格不同角色 CLIP-I 经验带 0.55-0.70；>0.70 说明角色过于相似。

primary_recommendation: strength 参数三档：0.30-0.40 低锁高姿态自由（动作/动态）；0.40-0.50 中锁平衡（多数场景默认）；0.50-0.60 高锁低姿态自由（面部特写/肖像）。3 测试场景用极值 0.35/0.40/0.55 覆盖该范围。
rationale: 确保角色在低/高 strength 两端都能保持。

primary_recommendation: Layer 1 STYLE_CORE：全局（项目所有角色），来自 style_genome。style_genome 输出后 frozen。示例: 'anime, cyberpunk era, cinematic lighting'。长度 20-50 tokens。
rationale: 全局风格基线；改需重跑 style_genome+版本 bump+级联所有角色 character_designer revision。跳过或模糊则 CORE 漂向 drawer 训练分布（千人一面同题材）。

extra_data.example: anime, cyberpunk era, cinematic lighting

primary_recommendation: Layer 2 STYLE_IDENTITY：每角色，来自 character_designer。通过 stress test 后 frozen。须具体（≥5 physical features），长度 50-150 tokens。示例: 'black long hair, red eyes, scar on left cheek, black trench coat'。
rationale: 模糊 identity（'cool guy with dark hair'）→下游 drift；具体 identity（'25yo male, shoulder-length black hair... 3cm scar'）→锁定身份。physical/outfit/accessories(if locked)/distinguishing marks 全部 frozen。

extra_data.example: black long hair, red eyes, scar on left cheek, black trench coat

primary_recommendation: Layer 3 STYLE_VARIANCE：每镜头/每场景，下游调用时填充。模板 '{lighting}, {weather}, {mood}'，长度 5-30 tokens/次替换。是角色锁后唯一可变层。
rationale: 允许场景变化同时不破坏身份。约束：不得与 IDENTITY 冲突（如 IDENTITY 黑发则 VARIANCE 不可写金发）、不得与 CORE 冲突、单场景内一致。

extra_data.example: {lighting}, {weather}, {mood}

primary_recommendation: 组合公式（每个下游 prompt）：'{STYLE_CORE}, {STYLE_IDENTITY}, {STYLE_VARIANCE}'。锁定后 style_prefix_locked 为此三层机械组合（VARIANCE 为字面占位符）。
rationale: 三层正交：CORE 全局、IDENTITY 角色、VARIANCE 场景；机械组合保证一致性。

primary_recommendation: STYLE_CORE 必填子字段：genre（题材 cyberpunk/wuxia/romance/horror）、era（时代 contemporary/medieval/future）、mood（全局美学 cinematic/anime/realistic）、lighting style（高调/低调/混合）。
rationale: style_genome 须输出这些子字段才算有效 CORE。

primary_recommendation: STYLE_IDENTITY 必填子字段：physical（发色/长度/发型、眼色/形状、脸型/颧骨/疤痕等）、outfit（主服色/款、次服、鞋）、accessories（默认配饰，仅常驻）、distinguishing marks（疤/纹身/胎记）。
rationale: 具体子字段保证 identity 可锁定、可审计。

primary_recommendation: 每角色 positive_prompt='{STYLE_PREFIX}, {scene_addons}'，negative_prompt='{negative_traits}, {general_negatives}'。negative_traits 须镜像该 demographic 每个默认漂移倾向，否则模型回退训练默认。
rationale: STYLE_PREFIX 定义角色'是什么'，negative prompt 定义'不是什么'；两者皆需。

primary_recommendation: 推荐方法：用 dreamina image2image 从 front 参考生成 ONE 张含 4 视角的转面图（16:9, 2k, model 5.0Pro），再 ffmpeg 裁成 4 个锚点。Volvo 验证一致性 8-9/10 vs 逐视角 2-3/10。
rationale: 模型单次推理画 4 视角，身份（脸型/肤色/发/装）共享同一 latent space；逐视角生成每次重采样身份致 drift。

primary_recommendation: 遗留方法 B：每视角单独 dreamina t2i/i2i 生成。已知问题：跨视角身份漂移，CLIP-I 跨视角对常低于 0.80。仅在 Method A 失败时用，且必须跑验证协议并重生失败视角。
rationale: 每次生成重采样身份；不推荐。

primary_recommendation: 16:9 横排 1×4（2560×1440，4列）裁切：crop=iw/4:ih:iw*N/4:0，N=0..3 对应 front/3q/side/back。
rationale: 确定性后处理（无 LLM）；按列等分裁切。

primary_recommendation: 9:16 竖屏 2×2 四宫格裁切（1440×2560，2行×2列）：左上 front / 右上 3q / 左下 side / 右下 back，crop=iw/2:ih/2:{0 or iw/2}:{0 or ih/2}。
rationale: 竖屏短剧默认形态；确定性裁切。

primary_recommendation: 竖屏剧集：始终先 16:9 横排 4 列生成（dreamina 最可靠全身材格式），再后处理 crop→stack→resize 成竖排 2×2（height=2560, 1440px canvas 居中）。Landscape 剧集跳过后处理直接消费 16:9。2026-08-03《她从深渊归来》验证。
rationale: dreamina 直接生成 9:16 2×2 不可靠（角色常被截到腰部'缺腿' bug）；恒 16:9 生成+竖屏后处理稳定全身材。方向不匹配会令 LiconMSR IC-LoRA 身份条件化失效。

primary_recommendation: Tier 0 基础身份转面（紧身衣 bodysuit，灰色，非场景服装）：text2image 生 front 参考→image2image 生转面图。锁脸+体型于中性服装无关态。1×4 横排（16:9, 2560×1440），列: 面部特写/front/side profile/back。输出 turnaround_sheets/base_{char_id}.png。
rationale: LiconMSR 优化：旧 2-tier 给 LiconMSR 单视角参考图欠佳；先锁裸身份护照再穿装。角色须立身站立 full-body neutral pose。

primary_recommendation: Tier 1 场景定妆转面：image2image 从 Tier 0 整张 base 转面图（非裁切单视角）生成角色穿场景服装的转面图。每 (character×scene) 一对生成一张。参考图须是整张 Tier 0 转面以保证 4 视角身份连贯。
rationale: LiconMSR 实际参考此 Tier 1 表；用整张 Tier 0 表（非 crop）保证跨视角身份连贯。

extra_data.ref_source: entire Tier 0 base turnaround sheet (not crop)

primary_recommendation: Tier 2 LiconMSR 参考分配：Node 40 参考槽接收整张 Tier 1 场景服装转面表（full multi-view sheet，非裁切单视角）。shot-list refs 格式：[char_s costume turnaround, 第二角色 turnaround, 背景 scene 图]。裁切步骤已移除——LiconMSR 接收 full sheet。
rationale: LiconMSR 的 IC-LoRA 训练于多视角参考表，喂同格式给推理时更丰富身份条件化，模型可在单参考槽内交叉引用 front/side/back。ArcFace 若实现可现场从 column 1 裁脸。

extra_data.ref_source: Tier 1 full scene costume turnaround sheet

primary_recommendation: 生成后用 vision_analyze 验证跨视角一致性：问 'Are all 4 views clearly the SAME person? Check face shape, hair, skin tone, clothing. Rate consistency 1-10.' 可接受 ≥7/10；<7 重生（在 prompt 显式重复 identity 特征）。
rationale: 客观一致性 + 视觉抽检互补。

primary_recommendation: CLIP-I Low + DINO-I Low：整体身份漂移。修复：重新生成变体。
rationale: 语义/风格与形状/结构双失败，说明身份根本未确立。

extra_data.fix: regenerate variants

rationale: 结构对但语义/风格偏（如服装变色、发质变），CORE 或 negative 未锁住。

rationale: 4D-Anchor 只锁空间维度不锁时间；黄金年龄细节最丰富，向两端延伸。

primary_recommendation: 1-2 分 主流安全: 可在任何平台原样制作。
rationale: 聚合分 1-2 对应 verdict 主流安全,action = Produce as-is on any platform。属 green 区。

primary_recommendation: 3-4 分 谨慎处理: 小幅重新框定;标准发行。
rationale: 聚合分 3-4 对应 verdict 谨慎处理,action = Minor reframing; standard release。属 yellow 区(偏安全)。

primary_recommendation: 5-6 分 平台分化: 需要分平台策略(sweet spot: meaningful + producible,有意义且可制作)。
rationale: 聚合分 5-6 对应 verdict 平台分化,action = Per-platform strategy needed。日常扫描将 4-6 区间 highlight 为甜点区。
source_section: Aggregate score interpretation / Daily scan filtering

primary_recommendation: 7-8 分 高风险: 大幅重新框定,或仅在有限平台发行。日常扫描中 downrank。
rationale: 聚合分 7-8 对应 verdict 高风险,action = Major reframing OR limited platform release。日常扫描对 ≥7 的 kernel downrank。

extra_data.action: Major reframing OR limited platform release

primary_recommendation: 9-10 分 禁忌: VETO——不能在任何 CN 平台制作;日常扫描 exclude(≥9)。硬性 VETO 触发条件:regulatory_redline=10,或 political_sensitivity≥9 且 regulatory_redline≥7,或 unspeakability_score=10。
rationale: 聚合分 9-10 对应 verdict 禁忌 = VETO。触发后标记 vetoed:true,不传递给下游 expert,输出 vetoed 报告。硬 VETO 条件独立于聚合分:regulatory_redline=10 / (political_sensitivity≥9 且 regulatory_redline≥7) / aggregate=10。

extra_data.action: VETO — cannot be made on any CN platform

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 1(开头)→ Snyder beats: Opening Image + Theme Stated + Set-Up + Catalyst + Debate;目标 runtime 0-20%。段落结尾(Catalyst)必须对齐 Snyder Catalyst(~10%)。
rationale: Snowflake-4 → Snyder 15-Beat 字段映射。段落 1 介绍主人公世界+触发事件。强制对齐锚点之一:段落 1 结尾的 Catalyst 落在 p.10±3(~10% runtime,±5% 容差)。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 2(三幕灾难 第 1 幕)→ Snyder beats: Break into Two + B-Story + Fun & Games + Midpoint;目标 runtime 20-50%。段落结尾(Midpoint)必须有极性反转,对齐 Snyder Midpoint(~50%)。
rationale: 段落 2 = 主角进入新世界+假胜利/假失败。强制对齐锚点:段落 2 结尾 Midpoint 落在 p.55±3(~50% runtime,且必须有极性反转,±5% 容差)。

extra_data.anchor: Midpoint ~50% (p.55 ± 3), must have polarity reversal, ±5% tolerance

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 3(三幕灾难 第 2 幕)→ Snyder beats: Bad Guys Close In + All Is Lost + Dark Night of the Soul;目标 runtime 50-77%。段落结尾(All Is Lost)对齐 Snyder All Is Lost(~68%)。
rationale: 段落 3 = 外部对手反扑+最低点。强制对齐锚点:段落 3 结尾 All Is Lost 落在 p.75±3(~68% runtime,±5% 容差)。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake-4 段落 4(结尾)→ Snyder beats: Break into Three + Finale + Final Image;目标 runtime 77-100%。主角找到解决方案+执行+视觉对照。
rationale: 段落 4 = 主角找到解决方案+执行+视觉对照。无强制锚点(前三段已锁三锚点)。

primary_recommendation: Snowflake 展开触发条件(三选一,默认不展开): unspeakability_score≥7,或 dramatic_potential.overall≥0.75,或 strata_overlay_coefficient≥1.7。满足任一即必须走雪花法展开;否则 snowflake_artifacts 字段为 null 直接交付 screenplay。
rationale: 决定一个 StoryKernel 是否值得走雪花法展开。高敏感 kernel 需更精细角色/场景设计承载合规降级;高潜力 kernel 值得展开为完整叙事 scaffold;多层叠加 kernel 需角色层面承接多冲突维度。trigger_reason 必须三选一。

primary_recommendation: kernel_id: string,格式 kernel_<8-char-hash>(由 structural_formula + created_at 确定性生成),创建时冻结,是所有下游消费者的 join key。
rationale: StoryKernel 的唯一标识。Frozen at creation。所有下游 expert 通过 kernel_id 关联。

extra_data.constraint: deterministic from structural_formula + created_at; frozen at creation; join key for all downstream consumers

primary_recommendation: strata_layers (array, REQUIRED): 1-3 个地层条目(4+ 不鼓励),每条含 layer(L1-L6)/layer_name/analysis/evidence_sources[]/structural_question/answer。每个条目必须有 ≥1 条 evidence_sources。
rationale: StoryKernel 的结构力来源。每条 evidence_sources 含 source/url/accessed_date/evidence_strength(high|medium|low)。VETO 条件之一:strata_layers.length≥4 = 叙事过载。

extra_data.constraint: 1-3 entries; each layer in L1-L6; each entry requires >=1 evidence_sources; required sub-fields: layer, layer_name, analysis, evidence_sources[], structural_question, answer

primary_recommendation: structural_formula (REQUIRED): 50-200 字单句,描述不可约的结构性冲突;一旦被下游消费即冻结。必须包含至少 1 个结构力(L1-L5)且至少 1 个人文后果。
rationale: StoryKernel 的统一主题,被 screenplay/style_genome 消费。验证:单句 50-200 字,含结构力+人文后果。反例:现代社会让人很焦虑(太抽象)/灵活就业者的故事(无结构冲突)。

extra_data.constraint: 50-200 chars, single sentence; must contain >=1 structural force (L1-L5) AND >=1 human consequence; frozen once consumed downstream

primary_recommendation: strata_overlay_coefficient: float 1.0-3.0,默认 1.0(单层);由地层组合计算而来,不可直接编辑。来源见 multi-strata-resonance.md 矩阵。
rationale: 反映多层叠加共振强度。2-layer 最高 1.8(L1+L4),3-layer 因果链可达 2.5(L1+L2+L4)。校验:系数必须与 layer 组合匹配。

extra_data.constraint: range 1.0-3.0; default 1.0 (single layer); computed from layer combination, not directly editable; must match layer combination per multi-strata-resonance.md

primary_recommendation: unspeakability_breakdown: object,4 个必填子字段 political_sensitivity/platform_algorithm_risk/audience_discomfort/regulatory_redline(各 1-10);聚合 unspeakability_score = round(0.20*P + 0.30*A + 0.15*D + 0.35*R)。
rationale: 聚合分权重 0.20/0.30/0.15/0.35。compliance_marketing 下游消费以识别风险维度。VETO 条件之一:unspeakability_score≥9。

extra_data.constraint: 4 required sub-fields each 1-10; aggregate = round(0.20*political + 0.30*platform + 0.15*audience + 0.35*regulatory); veto if aggregate >= 9

primary_recommendation: dramatic_potential: object,3 个 0.0-1.0 子字段 actionability/emotional_intensity/narrative_compression_fit,及 overall;overall = actionability*0.40 + emotional_intensity*0.35 + narrative_compression_fit*0.25。
rationale: 衡量戏剧化潜力。actionability=多容易转化为具体场景;emotional_intensity=观众情绪反应强度;narrative_compression_fit=多适合短剧 60-180s 格式。VETO 条件之一:overall<0.40(太弱无法戏剧化)。

primary_recommendation: target_audience_overlap: object,6 个必填 0.0-1.0 人口分段 male_18_25/male_25_35/male_35_50/female_18_25/female_25_35/female_35_50。VETO 条件之一:max<0.50(无明确受众)。
rationale: 描述受众重叠度,被 style_genome 消费以决定 genre/mood。校验:6 个分段必须全填。VETO:最大分段<0.50 = 无清晰受众。

extra_data.constraint: 6 required segments each 0.0-1.0 (male_18_25, male_25_35, male_35_50, female_18_25, female_25_35, female_35_50); veto if max < 0.50

primary_recommendation: platform_compliance_paths: object,以平台名为键、合规策略描述为值;CN 必填键 douyin/kuaishou/xiaohongshu/wechat_mini;可选 bilibili/youtube_shorts/tiktok_us。
rationale: compliance_marketing 下游消费以制定分发策略。每个 CN 平台有不同容忍度(抖音 1-5 谨慎 / 快手 1-6 / 小红书 1-6 / 微信小程序 1-7 tolerant / B站 1-6 / 视频号 1-5)。

extra_data.constraint: required CN keys: douyin, kuaishou, xiaohongshu, wechat_mini; optional: bilibili, youtube_shorts, tiktok_us

primary_recommendation: evidence_strength_aggregate: enum high/medium-high/medium/low/none,由 strata_layers[].evidence_sources[].evidence_strength 聚合。VETO 条件之一:= none(无数据源、纯推测)。
rationale: 聚合规则:全 high→high;high+medium 混合→medium-high;全 medium→medium;任一 low→low;evidence_sources 为空→none(降级模式)。

primary_recommendation: 主光 (Key light) 位于 camera 左/右 30-45°、高于主体 30-45°,强度为 100%(reference),作为主要光源塑造主体形态。
rationale: 经典 3-point lighting 标准的主光位置与强度,per Alton《Painting with Light》(1949)。是整个 lighting setup 的 reference 基准,fill 与 back 均以 key 强度为参照。

extra_data.position: camera 左/右 30-45°, 高于主体 30-45°

primary_recommendation: 补光 (Fill light) 位于 camera 对侧、与 key 同高度,强度为 key 的 30-50%,用于填充 key 产生的 shadow。
rationale: 3-point lighting 的补光位与强度,per Alton(1949)。Key-to-fill ratio 即由此 30-50% 比例衍生,决定 dramatic intensity。

extra_data.position: camera 对侧, 与 key 同高度

primary_recommendation: 背光 / 轮廓光 (Back / Rim light) 位于主体后方、高于主体 45-60°,强度为 key 的 50-100%,用于分离主体与 backdrop 并 highlight 主体轮廓。
rationale: 3-point lighting 的背光位与强度,per Alton(1949)。提供主体与背景的 depth 分离。

extra_data.position: 主体后方, 高于主体 45-60°

primary_recommendation: Comedy / 女频 romance:key-to-fill ratio 2:1,主光 warm 3200K,back light 为 soft rim;短剧修正为高调 + 柔光。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。高调低对比适配喜剧与女频 romance 的明亮基调;fill_ratio 0.5 由 2:1 ratio 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Drama / 文艺:key-to-fill ratio 4:1,主光 natural 5600K,back light 为 standard rim;短剧修正为中等 + 自然光。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。中等对比为标准剧情的标准强度;fill_ratio 0.25 由 4:1 ratio 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Thriller / 男频 revenge:key-to-fill ratio 8:1+,主光 cool 3200K + warm practical,back light 为 hard rim;短剧修正为低调 + 高对比。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。高对比营造悬疑与复仇戏剧张力;fill_ratio 0.125 由 8:1 ratio 衍生。注意 doc 原文标注 'cool 3200K + warm practical'。

primary_recommendation: Horror:key-to-fill ratio 16:1+,主光 cool 4200K from below,back light 为 minimal;短剧修正为极低调 + 红色 wash。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。极低调与自下而上的光源营造 horror 感;fill_ratio 0.0625 由 16:1 ratio 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Documentary / 现实主义:natural key-to-fill ratio,主光 natural 5600K,back light 为 ambient;短剧修正为自然光 + minimal setup。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。现实主义倾向自然光与极简布置,故 ratio 标为 natural 不强制数值。

primary_recommendation: Music video / 实验:variable key-to-fill ratio,colored 主光,colored back light;短剧修正为 stylized。
rationale: Per-genre lighting 协议表。实验性内容采用可变 ratio 与彩色光,需注意 colored light over-saturation(见 anti-pattern 3)。

primary_recommendation: Low ratio (2:1):高调 / 明亮 / 喜剧 / 女频 romance。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 决定 dramatic intensity 的第一档;fill_ratio 0.5 由 2:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Medium ratio (4:1):中等 / 标准剧情。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 第二档;fill_ratio 0.25 由 4:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: High ratio (8:1+):低调 / 戏剧 / 黑色 / 悬疑 / 男频 revenge。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 第三档;fill_ratio 0.125 由 8:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Very high ratio (16:1+):极低调 / 黑色电影 / horror。
rationale: Key-to-fill ratio 第四档;fill_ratio 0.0625 由 16:1 衍生。

primary_recommendation: Provider-agnostic abstract prompt built from five sections — [identity], [composition], [motion], [lighting], [mood]. It captures the intent of the prompt without committing to any model's grammar, e.g. [identity] char_wuji, male, 30s, gaunt cheekbones, rain-soaked coat / [composition] medium close-up, eye-line left-of-frame, shallow DoF / [motion] static held beat, micro-tremor in jaw / [lighting] key: amber sodium-vapor practical from frame-left / [mood] oppressive humidity, moral rot barely concealed.
rationale: Layer 1 of the provider-agnostic abstraction layer: this abstract structure is stable across model swaps. A thin per-model adapter maps it to model grammar (Layer 2), so swapping <image_primary>/<video_primary> requires only an adapter change, not an abstract-prompt rewrite.

adapter_examples: Veo adapter: Camera: ... Subject: ... Lighting: ... Mood: ...

primary_recommendation: dreamina (即梦/jimeng-5.0) uses a natural-language dominant grammar with optional structured tags: [character: <identity description>] [composition: <framing description>] [lighting: <lighting setup>] followed by a <mood sentence in natural language>. Natural-language sentences carry most of the visual information; structured tags anchor specific concerns.
rationale: dreamina is the mandated <image_primary> (FLUX 2 is PROHIBITED per 2026-07-28 directive). 9:16 vertical is supported natively for 短剧 format. Cross-ref visual_executor/drawer/dreamina-image-generation-execution.md for CLI deep-dive.

Duration 4-8s per clip (concatenate for longer). 9:16 supported. Veo 2 does NOT generate audio — pair with audio_pipeline.

primary_recommendation: Seedance 2.0 Director Formula: 'Subject + Action + Scene + Camera + Lighting/Style + Audio + Constraints'. Each element serves one intention (the shot's felt_intent); the prompt reads as a coherent director's instruction, not a tag list. Prompts are compiled from project state (clip contract + observed state + continuity locks), not written from scratch each call.
rationale: verified_date 2026-07 (Seedance 2.0 Skill OS v6.6.0). Closer to a shooting brief than structured tags — the key difference from FLUX/Veo/Kling. Prompt budget ~1000 chars (surface-specific; verify live). Duration 5-15s per clip. Native audio generation supported (ambience, SFX, dialogue).

extra_data.example: Medium close-up on char_wuji at eye-level, gentle compression; he lowers the letter and his hands go still on the table, eyes down; very slow push-in over the clip; soft warm window light behind him keeps his face plain while cool dusk fills the room outside; near-silence with a dripping tap and one chair scrape; preserve face identity and wardrobe from @Image1, do not alter letter or table geometry.

primary_recommendation: Seedance T2V mode: build the whole shot in compact layers. Key constraint — one visible beat, one endpoint.
rationale: T2V (text-to-video) is for building the whole shot from text alone; the prompt must commit to a single visible beat and a single endpoint to keep the clip coherent.

primary_recommendation: Seedance I2V mode: preserve @Image1 identity; add only motion. Say 'preserve @Image1 exactly'; do not re-describe the identity that the reference already defines.
rationale: I2V (image-to-video) anchors identity to @Image1; re-describing identity in prose both wastes tokens and risks contradicting the reference. State the preserve instruction explicitly.

primary_recommendation: Seedance V2V mode: transfer motion/camera/timing from @Video1. Restrict the transfer role explicitly so only the intended layer (motion, camera, or timing) is copied.
rationale: V2V (video-to-video) pulls motion/camera/timing from a reference clip; without an explicit role restriction the model may copy unwanted elements (identity, logo, scene ownership).

primary_recommendation: Seedance R2V mode: assign separate roles to each reference (e.g. @Image1 = identity, @Video1 = motion, @Audio1 = mood). One reference must not carry incompatible roles.
rationale: R2V (reference-to-video, multi-reference) lets each uploaded asset serve a distinct role; assigning conflicting roles to a single reference confuses the model.

extra_data.drafting_priority: Assign separate roles to each reference

primary_recommendation: Seedance FLF2V mode: @Image1 = first frame, @Image2 = last frame. State explicitly that @Image2 is the final visual target so the model interpolates toward it.
rationale: FLF2V (first-last-frame-to-video) drives the clip from a defined start and end frame; without naming @Image2 as the final target the endpoint is ambiguous.

extra_data.key_constraint: State @Image2 is the final visual target

primary_recommendation: Seedance Edit mode: @Video1 is the source clip; change only one layer. Preserve composition and timing of the original.
rationale: Edit mode alters a single layer of an existing clip; preserving composition and timing keeps the rest of the shot stable.

primary_recommendation: Seedance Extend mode: continue from accepted footage only. Route to the continuation protocol (source-gated continuation; observed end-state overrides planned state).
rationale: Extend mode lengthens an accepted clip; the continuation protocol gates how many consecutive output-sourced generations are allowed before a canonical re-anchor is required.

primary_recommendation: Seedance 2.0 binds uploaded assets with @-mentions typed directly in the prompt: @Image1–@Image9 (CN @图片1–@图片9, max 9), @Video1–@Video3 (CN @视频1–@视频3, max 3), @Audio1–@Audio3 (CN @音频1–@音频3, max 3). Tags must be written exactly — do not translate, renumber, or rewrite as [Image1]; the @-parser silently fails on bracket form.
rationale: Reference tags are the binding mechanism between uploaded assets and prompt roles. The @-parser is literal; bracket form and renumbering break binding silently.

primary_recommendation: Before writing prompt prose, assign each reference asset a role. Image good roles: identity, product, pose, costume, environment, first frame, last frame (avoid asking it to define unseen motion). Video good roles: motion, camera, pacing, blocking, timing, gesture rhythm (avoid copying protected identity/logo/scene ownership). Audio good roles: rhythm, tempo, mood, ambience, delivery tone, music texture (avoid assuming voice/song/likeness authorization).
rationale: Explicit role assignment prevents the model from over-extending a reference (e.g. asking an image to define motion, or a video to copy protected identity).

image.avoid: asking it to define unseen motion

video.avoid: copying protected identity, logo, or scene ownership

audio.avoid: assuming voice, song, or likeness authorization

primary_recommendation: Seedance 2.0 enforces a source-gated continuation model: (1) observed state overrides planned state — if a generated clip ends differently from plan, the next prompt starts from the actual ending; (2) extension depth — consecutive output-sourced generations since last canonical re-anchor, default ≤2, hard ceiling ≤3, at cap must re-anchor from canonical references; (3) clip contract — already_happened / this_clip_only / reserved_for_later arrays constrain prompt scope; (4) canon revision — increments on every accepted take/deviation/re-anchor; project-state JSON is the single source of truth.
rationale: Critical for multi-shot sequences. Continuation gates prevent identity/geometry drift when generation deviates from plan, which is the norm for AI video.

rules: extension depth: consecutive output-sourced generations since last canonical re-anchor (default ≤2, hard ceiling ≤3)
clip contract: already_happened / this_clip_only / reserved_for_later arrays constrain prompt scope
canon revision increments on every accepted take / deviation / re-anchor

primary_recommendation: Each Seedance clip carries a clip contract with three arrays that constrain prompt scope: already_happened (events established in prior clips), this_clip_only (what this single clip must show), reserved_for_later (events explicitly held back for future clips).
rationale: The clip contract scopes the prompt so the model does not try to render future events or re-render past ones, keeping multi-shot continuity coherent. Schema: clip-contract.schema.json.

primary_recommendation: Shot Intent JSON (engine-agnostic, produced by P09, consumed by P11): felt_intent + visible_behavior + camera_intent {shot_size, movement, axis, endpoint} + lighting_intent {key_source, ratio, temperature} + audio_intent + continuity {already_happened, this_clip_only, reserved_for_later, locks}. felt_intent and visible_behavior are MANDATORY; the directing engine refuses emotion words (sad/tense) and requires visible gestures.
rationale: Layer 1 of the LTX→Seedance bridge (live since 2026-07-12). Survives engine swap — switching from LTX to Seedance = swapping only the Layer 2 adapter. P09ShotIntent + P09ShotItem Pydantic models validate it.

shot_intent.visible_behavior: 她放下信，双手静止不动

primary_recommendation: P11 take_log entry (Seedance retake-protocol inspired): {take_n, shot_id, changed_variable, seed, verdict, evidence}. verdict ∈ keep / fix_in_post / edit / re_roll / rewrite. Rule: same flaw ≥2 takes → must rewrite prompt (not a third re-roll).
rationale: Layer-2/3 structured iteration tracking. Replaces blind 抽卡 (change seed and resubmit) with a five-verdict triage and attempt budget, saving GPU budget when the prompt is the actual problem. P11TakeLogEntry + P11VideoClip Pydantic models validate it.

The next shot's prompt compilation reads observed_end_state of the parent, not the planned_end_state.
rationale: Seedance's core innovation: the next clip's prompt is compiled from the actual ending state of the accepted footage, not the planned state. Without this, multi-shot continuity breaks when generation deviates from plan. P11ObservedEndState validates it.

primary_recommendation: Pattern 1 — define the abstract prompt once (provider-agnostic), then write a thin adapter per model that maps abstract sections → model grammar. Swapping models = swapping adapters, not rewriting prompts (e.g. flux2_adapter maps identity/composition/lighting/mood to tagged form; veo2_adapter maps motion/identity/lighting/mood to descriptor-prefix form).
rationale: Decouples prompt intent from model grammar, so a model swap is an adapter-only change. This is the foundation that lets <image_primary>/<video_primary> placeholders stay abstract in SKILL.md.

primary_recommendation: Pattern 2 — all models in a pipeline share the same consistency_context.json (identity / style / composition carry). Only the per-call prompt grammar differs by model.
rationale: A single carry artifact keeps identity/style/composition stable across image and video calls while letting each model receive grammar-appropriate prompts.

primary_recommendation: Pattern 3 — if <image_primary> fails (OOM, timeout, quality < threshold), fall back to <image_fallback>. The abstract prompt stays the same; only the adapter swaps. Same for <video_primary> → <video_fallback>.
rationale: Fallback chains preserve the abstract prompt across primary/fallback model swaps, so a degraded model doesn't force a prompt rewrite.

primary_recommendation: LTX → Seedance field migration map (from P09 current output → Seedance equivalent): intent≈felt_intent; camera_movement≈camera_intent.movement; shot_type≈camera_intent.shot_size; axis_line≈camera_intent.axis; emotion→Seedance requires visible behavior instead; ltx_prompt is engine-specific (NOT reusable for Seedance); character_refs[{name,turnaround_path,role}]≈@Image1 controls identity; scene_ref≈@Image2 controls environment; style_prefix≈Seedance directorial voice; color_guidance(CxSxZ)≈Seedance lighting intent.

rationale: Switching from LTX to Seedance = swapping the Layer 2 adapter only; Layer 1 Shot Intent stays constant. This is the architectural principle that makes the engine swap cheap.

primary_recommendation: Template instantiation workflow: (1) assemble abstract prompt from visual_intent + style_genome_5d + character_assets; (2) select model target (still→<image_primary>, motion→<video_primary>) by VRAM + latency budget; (3) apply model adapter (FLUX/Veo/Kling template); (4) load consistency_context (LoRA/IP-Adapter/InstantID + style vector + composition locks); (5) token budget check — if >4000 trigger prompt_overload fallback; (6) emit model_prompts.json.
rationale: Canonical 6-step workflow that turns intent into a model-ready prompt while staying under the 4000-token ceiling and preserving cross-call consistency.

primary_recommendation: Model swap protocol: (1) re-verify prompt grammar (structured tags vs natural language vs descriptor prefixes); (2) re-verify token counting (new tokenizer may count differently); (3) re-verify consistency refs (LoRA/IP-Adapter/InstantID may need re-training); (4) update verified_date stamp (stale templates must be re-verified quarterly); (5) update this ref with new model grammar + example.
rationale: Quarterly re-verification is mandatory — model versions change quarterly and prompt-token mappings drift. The verified_date stamp is load-bearing.

rationale: Empirical attention degradation curve for stable_2026 horizons. Below 1000 tokens the model honors every constraint — ideal for atomic single-concern shots.

primary_recommendation: Section 1 — Identity (character refs, wardrobe, posture): typical 80-200 tokens. Stability: stable (carry via system prompt).
rationale: Standard 5-section chunk. Identity is stable across calls in a scene, so it belongs in the system prompt (cached) rather than repeated per call.

primary_recommendation: Section 2 — Composition (framing, eye-line, DoF): typical 50-150 tokens. Stability: stable (carry via system prompt).
rationale: Composition conventions (axis locks, screen direction) are stable across a scene and should be carried, not repeated.

primary_recommendation: Section 3 — Motion (camera move, subject motion): typical 30-80 tokens. Stability: per-call variance.
rationale: Motion changes shot-to-shot, so it lives in the user prompt as per-call variance.

primary_recommendation: Section 4 — Lighting (key, fill, practicals): typical 50-120 tokens. Stability: per-call variance.
rationale: Lighting deltas (amber key vs blue key) change shot-to-shot; keep in the user prompt.

primary_recommendation: Section 5 — Mood (emotional tone, atmosphere): typical 30-80 tokens. Stability: per-call variance. Total standard 5-section chunk = 240-630 tokens, well under the 4000 ceiling.
rationale: Mood deltas change per call. The full 5-section chunk totals 240-630 tokens — well under ceiling.

primary_recommendation: <video_primary> (Veo-class) provider context window ~1024-4096 prompt tokens; effective prompt budget 1024-4000. Moderate — hierarchical prompts recommended.

primary_recommendation: LLM orchestrator (GPT-class) context window 128k+; effective prompt budget 4000 ceiling (self-imposed). The 4000 ceiling is a quality threshold, NOT a hard context-window limit.
rationale: Key insight: the 4000-token ceiling is NOT a context-window limit for most providers — it is an attention-quality threshold. Context window = max accepted length (hard provider limit); token budget = length at which output quality is still acceptable (soft quality threshold).

rationale: The canonical 5-step fallback when token count exceeds the 4000 ceiling, before escalating to intent-layer decomposition.
